notes.title: Patch note of July 4 2022
notes.notes:
This last patch solves many bugs that you have reported to us but also adjusts some elements of the game, before the next content update.

notes.title: Patch notes of Intro Revamp, Night-Time Open PvP And Instances Update
notes.notes:
After many months, we are happy to announce Intro Revamp, Night-Time Open PvP And Instances Update for Nightmare you can find below this the patch notes.

Based on the feedback we received over the past few months, we have completely revamped the intro and lower level experience - giving it not only more direction in terms of how to play, but also a much smoother experience. You can help us create a successful relaunch by starting a new character and trying out the start of the game afresh, then relaying any feedback to the team.

notes.title: About Overhaul Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

As part of the global Overhaul Update, we have decided for the good of the game and to focus on the actual needs reported by players, to delay all of the PvP content originally planned.

In order to make the game better for old and new players alike, as our last article on our website indicated, we are working on a global rework of many systems, like damage, monsters and much more.

A first update will be planned on the Test Server as soon as we feel that we are ready to deploy a first draft of our work so that it is improved thanks to your feedback, which will hopefully be numerous.

PvP Balancing will not be available until the release of the Overhaul Update.
The many changes planned for the title will affect pvp balance, and therefore we will be holding off on this element until we can fix the major issues at hand.

This is why the Overhaul Update will be on the Test Server for a long time as we all find a balance for each element of the game.

For us, doing this rework is a way to breathe new life into Nightmare and we always want to make it better.

The Nightmare Team.

Hello everyone !


We are happy to share our 23rd patch with you. We've had a long discussion about the recent updates and changes on Nightmare and we have decided to space the release of updates to two days per week.


This patch notes includes new features as well as the latest live changes.

New features

Revamped crafting system,
Carbuncles are mods that you can apply to your gear when crafting to provide bonus effects like life-steal, they drops from ores & raid boss.
Raid Bosses will finally be re-released. Raid bosses have higher drop rates than regular bosses on dungeon gear, drop high level Guardian ability books, drop Magichest keys, and other rare items,
Magichests will be fully implemented allowing players to get their hands on some treasure. Magichests have random drops, some of which are extremely rare & valuable,
Kolasi - The Underground PvP City, the city will be released during the patch and available to everyone,
Home of The Syndicate, Kolasi has 24/7 pvp for those who want to hone their skills or just want an option to pvp in the day. A dangerous Werebear will spawn here, but he does so randomly meaning players must find his location. Rare resources will also spawn here, and quests will be available for Red Diamond. Red Diamond may be used to purchase rare items.
Insect Lord Entomo is a raid boss that is a combination of humanoid and insect. It will spawn after 100 players kills on Kolasi,
Added a smart AoE System, this system will be added to bosses and rolled out over the course of this patch live for more interesting boss battles,
Added player dueling.

notes.title: Nightmare : Pets Update
notes.notes:
Hello players,

This major update for Nightmare introduces a new Pets system but also a big change to how dungeons work.

Let us introduce you to this new update feature, change and bug fix.
Update featureA new pet window containing Pet stats & behaviours,You can set your pet to be aggressive (Attack any targets in range),You can set your pet to be defensive (Attack any targets in range that have attacked the owner),You can set your pet to follow the owner and ignore all Npc's,You can also set your pet to fight in either close combat range or keep its distance and fight with only spells,If a pet goes outside of its range it will teleport to its owner (No more pets getting stuck when traveling long distances!),Pets no longer waste spells healing/shielding you on full health. They now won't cast these spells until the targets health drops below 80%,Coming SoonThe ability to set your pets name,The ability to spend stat points for your pet,Pet spells are going to become dropable from bosses which can taught to your pet,Global exp & luck potions.Dungeon changes
We have had a lot of complaints regarding players who prefer to PvE (and rightfully so) getting forced into PvP scenarios. We also understand and respect our PvPers right to PvP as for them its the entire purpose of the game. But what is not fun is getting killed when you just are sitting back and relaxing just trying to enjoy the game for what it is. We believe this will offer a solution for both types of players. PvP mode needs some risk vs reward elements so we added a 10% Luck & Experience buff when fighting in a PvP dungeon instance which we believe is a fair compromise. We will be actively monitoring the health of the 2 dungeon queues over time.

We have decided to remove PvP in the earliest dungeons, (We may decide to add it later due to popular demand) but all of the following high level dungeons will be split into 2 map instances. One instance for PvP and the other being for PvE.
